scope: Every row of requirements section 18.2; not a claim of clause coverage for the whole document.

gates.required_proof_verbatim: DST transitions, seasonal boundaries, exact rational 7,200-frame combined allocation, both MP4 timescales, no double-owned source samples or cross-segment temporal context.
Real native JPEGs at admitted cadence, request total deadline, stale/cached response detection, clock discontinuity handling and no catch-up storms.
Atomic TAR/index bundle, writer fencing across failure/reconnect, quota/backpressure, visible outage gaps and idempotent cleanup.
Full decode and exact geometry/fps/duration; jitter-aware reconstruction; linear-light exposure; gap/coverage handling; real twilight/cloud/foliage/seam/night comparison; CPU deadline.
Actual admitted sharing, resident-service SLO preservation, peak VRAM/host budget, abort/rollback and CPU fallback.
Every supported family/row/unknown field preserved, exact bytes, dedup/event counts, out-of-order/replay freshness, bounded spool/recovery, all retained history queryable.
Qualified placement/failover, extension availability, storage policy, migration rollback and WAL outage budget.
No anonymous read; real broker authorization; negative prefix/action/multipart tests; real Barman backup/archive/restore/retention through the boundary.
Crash between upload/commit, no broken visible references, SHA-256 integrity, revision CAS, independent cameras, poster and sidecar completeness.
Mobile/accessibility/date navigation, freshness, bounded history/search, all weather-domain playback/download/range semantics and supported-browser matrix.

All three cameras; native-byte/hash fidelity, enforced day/hour/camera FKs; 23/24/25-hour days and repeated offsets; dawn/dusk pin race; upload/commit restart; missing-slot truth; video expiry does not remove five-year originals.
Six products for a complete cycle; versioned camera regions including frontyard; UTC bins/gaps and source-only lineage; keyboard/click seek; durable extraction before raw cleanup.

All three cameras; trusted upper time bound plus 600 seconds at origin; guessed URL/HEAD/range/alias/cache tests; same embargo for newly archived still derivatives; stale/clock/error behavior and bounded/coalesced work.

Bidirectional plot/video/keogram/event UTC navigation; overnight/DST/gaps and evidence precision; one active mobile player; measured event feed works with AI offline and makes no outbound product notifications.

Coverage-aware records/rain, duration-weighted wind rose, local astronomy, period comparisons/exports; null versus zero, equivalent units, late-data revision and exact measured predicates during model outage.

Authenticated CAS/audit, human-override precedence, private favorites/notes exclusion, correction-aware sidecars/indexing and eligible poster sources; allowed/denied framing, self-hosted assets and 15-second weather freshness.
Fresh temporal-order controls, complete schema/evidence validation, exact clip mapping, numerical grounding, stale revision rejection and honest degraded modes.
Verified profile/dimensions, correct pgvector representation, typed filters, exact baseline/ANN recall, bounded queries, update/withdrawal/reindex and outage behavior.
Full plus exact WAL enrollment; missing-object/WAL mismatch rejection; inference-independent B2-only restore; new archive identity; retained historical recovery references.
Sanitized repository/history/artifacts, isolated untrusted CI, pinned local images, scoped secrets/roles and no public runtime dependency.

rules: Every sentence and qualifier in required_proof_verbatim must have evidence; an area cannot pass on one smoke test.
Synthetic tests cannot establish live device, storage durability, browser, model capability or recovery behavior.
GPU acceleration is conditional; the phase-1 nine-GPU inventory and CPU fallback design remain mandatory.
WX-33 and WX-35 integrate evidence and cannot substitute for producer proof.
Disruptive tests use admitted isolated infrastructure; planning does not authorize production disruption.
An evidence receipt with a limitation that defeats required proof leaves the gate open.

| Linked exploration/events | Bidirectional plot/video/keogram/event UTC navigation; overnight/DST/gaps and evidence precision; one active mobile player; measured event feed works with AI offline and makes no outbound product notifications. |
| Almanac/filters | Coverage-aware records/rain, duration-weighted wind rose, local astronomy, period comparisons/exports; null versus zero, equivalent units, late-data revision and exact measured predicates during model outage. |
| Editorial/embed | Authenticated CAS/audit, human-override precedence, private favorites/notes exclusion, correction-aware sidecars/indexing and eligible poster sources; allowed/denied framing, self-hosted assets and 15-second weather freshness. |

| Search | Verified profile/dimensions, correct pgvector representation, typed filters, exact baseline/ANN recall, bounded queries, update/withdrawal/reindex and outage behavior. |
| DR | Full plus exact WAL enrollment; missing-object/WAL mismatch rejection; inference-independent B2-only restore; new archive identity; retained historical recovery references. |
| Public supply chain | Sanitized repository/history/artifacts, isolated untrusted CI, pinned local images, scoped secrets/roles and no public runtime dependency. |

Use meaningful deterministic fixtures and failure tests for these data/durability boundaries. Do not write tests that merely restate constants while leaving publication, replay, fencing or recovery untested. Perform disruptive tests only through the approved isolated environment/change process. Mark incomplete gates clearly; a successful UI demo is not production acceptance.
validation_instruction: Meaningful deterministic failure tests for data/durability; isolated approved disruptive tests only; incomplete gates remain explicit; UI demo is not production acceptance.
